external_id.description: An optional external identifier for your own tracking

EmailsBroadcastStatsAttributes.title: Email Broadcast Stats
EmailsBroadcastStatsAttributes.description: Delivery progress, engagement and revenue for one email broadcast over its send window. Counts are unique contacts unless noted; rates are whole percentages (0-100); money is a decimal string in `currency`.

broadcast.description: The broadcast these stats belong to

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary values (e.g. USD, EUR). `null` when the workspace has no currency set; `revenue` then sums every currency the broadcast's orders were paid in.

timerange.description: The send window the stats cover

from.description: When sending began. For a broadcast that has not started sending, 90 days before `to`; every number is then zero.

to.description: End of the window, two weeks after sending completed, or now while the broadcast has not completed, capped at 90 days after sending began.

total.description: Audience size recorded when the broadcast sent, summed over every send of the broadcast (a send in the contacts' time zones has one per zone). `null` until the first send has run.

queued.description: Contacts in batches that have not started sending yet (scheduled, waiting for the split-test winner, paused, or halted by a deliverability health check)

processing.description: Contacts in batches being sent right now

sent.description: Contacts the email was sent to

performance.description: Engagement over the send window. Rates are rounded to whole percentages, so a share under 0.5% reads 0 next to a non-zero count; the counts are authoritative.

delivered.description: Contacts the email was sent to (the same number as `progress.sent`)

opened.description: Total opens, counting repeat opens by the same contact

unique_opens.description: Contacts who opened at least once

clicked.description: Total clicks, counting repeat clicks by the same contact

unique_clicks.description: Contacts who clicked at least once

unsubscribed.description: Contacts who unsubscribed from this email

spam_complaints.description: Contacts who reported this email as spam

open_rate.description: Unique opens as a whole percentage (0-100) of the audience

click_rate.description: Unique clicks as a whole percentage (0-100) of the audience

click_to_open_rate.description: Unique clicks as a whole percentage (0-100) of unique opens

bounce_rate.description: Bounces as a whole percentage (0-100) of the audience

unsubscribe_rate.description: Unsubscribes as a whole percentage (0-100) of the audience

revenue.description: Orders attributed to the broadcast, meaning the buyer reached the order through one of its links, summed across every send of the broadcast. Only live-mode transactions in the workspace currency are counted; a workspace with no currency set (`currency` is `null`) has every currency summed.

total.description: Revenue attributed to the broadcast (paid minus refunded), as a decimal string in `currency`

orders_count.description: Orders with at least one paid transaction attributed to the broadcast

per_recipient.description: Revenue divided by the audience, as a decimal string in `currency`

per_unique_open.description: Revenue divided by unique opens, as a decimal string in `currency`

per_unique_click.description: Revenue divided by unique clicks, as a decimal string in `currency`

EmailsBroadcastsSendActionAttributes.title: Email Broadcast Send Actions
EmailsBroadcastsSendActionAttributes.description: An asynchronous action that sends (or schedules) the delivery of a parent email broadcast. The action runs in the background; poll `performed_count` vs `target_count` to track progress.

send_type.description: The delivery strategy used for this send action.

target_ids.description: Array of broadcast IDs targeted by this send action. For a standard broadcast send, this contains the single broadcast ID being delivered.

target_count.description: Total number of contacts targeted by this send action. `null` until the async job has resolved the audience count.

performed_count.description: Number of contacts processed so far. Poll alongside `target_count` to track async delivery progress.

scheduled_for.description: Datetime the send is scheduled to begin. Reflects the `send_at` passed at creation, adjusted to the workspace time zone. `null` for immediate sends.

started_at.description: Datetime the async delivery job began processing contacts. `null` until the job has started.

completed_at.description: Datetime the async delivery job finished. `null` until delivery is complete.

created_by_id.description: Reserved; `null` in most cases. The member who triggered the send is recorded in `approved_by_id` instead.

approved_by_id.description: ID of the workspace membership that created/approved this send action — the member that triggered the send. Populated for API-created sends.

broadcast_id.description: The ID of the email broadcast being delivered. Convenience field derived from `target_ids[0]`.

EmailsBroadcastsSendActionParameters.title: Email Broadcast Send Actions
EmailsBroadcastsSendActionParameters.description: Parameters for creating a send action. The request body is optional — a bodyless POST sends the broadcast immediately.

send_at.description: Optional ISO 8601 datetime. When provided, the broadcast is scheduled for that day at the given hour in the workspace's time zone. Omit (or send an empty body) to dispatch immediately.

DnsRecord.title: DNS Record
DnsRecord.description: A single DNS record to add at the domain's DNS provider to configure email transport (or, for the return path, bounce handling).

name.description: The DNS host/name to create the record on (e.g. `example.com` or `_dmarc.example.com`).

value.description: The exact value to paste at the registrar for this record.

ttl.description: Recommended TTL, in seconds, for the record.

verified.description: Whether this specific record has been confirmed live at the DNS provider. It reflects stored DNS verification state; call `verifyEmailsDomains` to re-check.

name.description: The sending domain name (lowercase), e.g. `example.com` - the part after the `@` shared by every email address created on this domain.

ownership_verified.description: Whether ClickFunnels has confirmed that this workspace owns the domain name. It becomes true when the same name is connected to this workspace as a website/hosting domain whose ownership is verified - done in the ClickFunnels app, not through this API. No API call can make it true; ask the customer to connect the domain.

verified.description: Whether email transport is verified. True once DKIM, SPF, and DMARC are all verified via DNS, or when a verified SMTP setting exists. This field does not prove domain ownership and is not sufficient by itself to send.

ready_for_sending.description: Whether addresses on this custom domain can be used as senders. True only when both `ownership_verified` and the transport-only `verified` field are true. The return-path record is independent and does not control this value.

dkim_verified.description: Whether the domain's DKIM DNS record is verified.

spf_verified.description: Whether the domain's SPF DNS record is verified.

dmarc_verified.description: Whether the domain's DMARC DNS record is verified.

smtp_verified.description: Whether email transport is verified via a verified SMTP setting (an alternative to DKIM/SPF/DMARC verification). When true, `verified` can be true while dkim_verified/spf_verified/dmarc_verified are false; ownership must still be verified before `ready_for_sending` becomes true.

return_address_verified.description: Whether the domain's return-path CNAME record (used for bounce handling) is verified. This is independent of `verified` and `ready_for_sending` and is not required for either one to become true.

dkim_record.description: The DKIM TXT record to add at the registrar. `null` until the DKIM key has been generated, which happens automatically shortly after the domain is created; POST the same name again to retry provisioning if it stays `null`.

spf_record.description: The SPF TXT record to add at the registrar.

dmarc_record.description: The DMARC TXT record to add at the registrar.

return_address_record.description: The return-path CNAME record to add at the registrar (used for bounce handling).

next_steps.description: Plain-English guidance you can surface to users. It distinguishes the required ownership step (connect the domain to the workspace in ClickFunnels) and the required transport records from the recommended ClickFunnels return path, accounts for verified SMTP, and explains how to re-check readiness.

example.name: example.com
next_steps: Connect example.com to this workspace in ClickFunnels so ownership is confirmed. Addresses on this domain cannot send until it is, even once every record below verifies.
Add dkim_record, spf_record, and dmarc_record at the DNS provider for example.com to authenticate email transport.
Recommended for ClickFunnels bounce handling: add return_address_record at the DNS provider.
DNS changes can take up to 48 hours to propagate. Re-check with POST /api/v2/emails/domains/QrStUv/verify; results are cached for about 10 minutes.
Manual setup help: https://support.myclickfunnels.com/docs/email-settings-how-to-verify-email-dns-records

SplitTestStepAttributes.title: Split Test Step
SplitTestStepAttributes.description:
A split test step wraps an existing page in a funnel in a two-branch split. Each
variant carries the `show_page_step` + `page` attached to that branch (both `null`
when the branch is empty), plus the branch's traffic `weight` (0..100).

funnel.description: The funnel containing this split test.

variants.description: Ordered variants. Binary split tests always have 2 entries.

show_page_step.description: The ShowPageStep function attached to this branch, or null if empty.

page.description: The page attached to this branch, or null if empty.

weight.description: Percentage of traffic sent to this branch (0..100). Branches must sum to 100.

SplitTestStepParametersCreate.title: Create Split Test Step
SplitTestStepParametersCreate.description:
Parameters for wrapping an existing page in a new split test. Provide 1 or 2 variants.
The first variant's `page_id` must already be attached to a step in this funnel's
workflow (that page gets wrapped). The second variant's `page_id` must be a fresh page
(not already used by any step anywhere). No cloning occurs.

### Positioning the split

By default (no `show_page_step_id`), the split lands at the funnel entry —
`sort_order 0` under the workflow root — with all surviving steps moved into a
`Root Step after Sequence End` convergence sequence positioned right after the split.

When `show_page_step_id` references an existing show-page step in this funnel, the
split is inserted **after that step** under the same parent, and steps
N+1...end are migrated under the convergence sequence. This is the "split between
step N and step N+1" shape.

See [Positioning the split](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/funnels/skill.md#positioning-the-split) in the [Funnels Skill](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/funnels/skill.md) for picking a safe anchor step, and [Placing an external (SDK) page in a branch](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/funnels/skill.md#placing-an-external-sdk-page-in-a-branch) to use a page you host yourself as a variant.

page_id.description: Page ID (required on the first variant; optional on the second).

weight.description: Traffic weight (0..100). Either omit on both variants (defaults 100/0 for 1 variant or 50/50 for 2) or provide on both.

show_page_step_id.description:
Optional. Insert the new split AFTER the workflow step that wraps this
`show_page_step`. Accepts a numeric `Workflows::Steps::ShowPageStep` id
or its obfuscated public id (you can read either off any page response).
When omitted, the split lands at funnel entry.
Caution: creating a split moves the wrapped step inside a branch sequence,
so an id fetched earlier may no longer sit where you think — read the
funnel structure immediately before creating, and note that anchoring on
a step inside another split's branch nests the new split in that branch.

SplitTestStepParametersUpdate.title: Update Split Test Step
SplitTestStepParametersUpdate.description:
Parameters for updating a split test's variants. The `variants` array length must
equal the current number of branches (2 for the standard binary case). Each entry may
provide any subset of `{ page_id, weight }`.

page_id.description: New page to attach/swap to this branch. Must be a fresh page (no existing ShowPageStep).

weight.description: Traffic weight (0..100). If any variant provides weight, all must — and they must sum to 100.

ConditionalSplitStepAttributes.title: Conditional Split Step
ConditionalSplitStepAttributes.description:
A conditional split step routes contacts down one of two branches based on whether
they match a contact filter (`condition`). Each branch carries the
`show_page_step` + `page` attached to that branch (both `null` when the branch is
empty). The first branch (`branches[0]`) is the **matched** branch; the second
(`branches[1]`) is the **unmatched** branch.

See the [Funnels Skill](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/funnels/skill.md#conditional-split-steps) for the full conditional-split surface (positioning, multi-page branches, attaching filters).

The `condition.filter_id` is the public id of a RefineFilter scoped to the same workspace.
Pass it on PATCH to attach or replace the filter. Create filters first via `POST /api/v2/workspaces/{workspace_id}/refine_filters` — see [Attaching a filter](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/funnels/skill.md#attaching-a-filter) and the cross-link to [Applying filters to conditional split steps](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/refine-filters/skill.md#applying-filters-to-conditional-split-steps).

On `GET /funnels/{funnel_id}/conditional_split_steps/{id}` (show), `condition.filter` is always
included as a full RefineFilter object. On the list endpoint it is included only when
`expand[]=filter` is passed.

funnel_id.description: ID of the funnel containing this conditional split

filter_id.description: Public id of the attached RefineFilter. `null` when no filter has been set up.

is_setup.description: True when a filter has been attached and the conditional split is ready to evaluate.

filter.description:
The full RefineFilter object for the attached filter. Always present on the show endpoint.
Present on the list endpoint only when `expand[]=filter` is requested. Absent (key omitted)
when no filter is attached or the expand param is not passed.

show_page_step.description: The ShowPageStep function attached to this branch, or null if empty.

page.description: The page attached to this branch, or null if empty.

ConditionalSplitStepParametersCreate.title: Create Conditional Split Step
ConditionalSplitStepParametersCreate.description:
Parameters for adding a new conditional split step to a funnel's workflow. The split
always starts as a 2-branch tree (`matched` first, `unmatched` second). All fields
below are optional — providing none creates an empty unconfigured split that
the caller can fill in later via PATCH.

### `condition`

Supply `filter_id` — the public id of a RefineFilter scoped to the same workspace.
Create filters first via `POST /api/v2/workspaces/{workspace_id}/refine_filters`.
Raw numeric ids are rejected for cross-tenant safety. See [Attaching a filter](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/funnels/skill.md#attaching-a-filter)
and [Applying filters to conditional split steps](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/refine-filters/skill.md#applying-filters-to-conditional-split-steps).

### Branches

Optional `branches` array — up to 2 entries; `branches[0]` is the matched branch,
`branches[1]` is the unmatched branch. Each entry may carry either:

- `page_id` — a single fresh `user_page` id to attach as the branch's first step.
- `page_ids` — an array of fresh `user_page` ids to attach in order. Use this to
  build a branch with multiple sequential pages (e.g. matched users see Welcome →
  Onboarding → CTA, while unmatched users see Email Capture → Welcome).

`page_id` and `page_ids` are mutually exclusive per branch entry. Each page
referenced must be in the same workspace and not already wired to any
`ShowPageStep` anywhere.

### Positioning

See `show_page_step_id` semantics — identical to the split test step endpoint.

filter_id.description: Public id of a RefineFilter in this workspace. Create filters via `POST /api/v2/workspaces/{workspace_id}/refine_filters`.

branches.description: Optional 0..2 branch entries; `branches[0]` is the matched branch, `branches[1]` is the unmatched branch.

page_id.description: Optional id of a page with no existing show-page step (an unattached internal page or a standalone external page) to attach as the branch's first step. Mutually exclusive with `page_ids`. See [Placing an external (SDK) page in a branch](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/funnels/skill.md#placing-an-external-sdk-page-in-a-branch) in the [Funnels Skill](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/funnels/skill.md) for creating the standalone external page you reference here.

page_ids.description:
Optional list of fresh `user_page` ids to attach in order under this branch.
Use this to build branches with multiple sequential steps. Mutually exclusive with `page_id`.

show_page_step_id.description:
Optional. Insert the new conditional split AFTER the workflow step that wraps
this `show_page_step`. Accepts a numeric `Workflows::Steps::ShowPageStep` id
or its obfuscated public id (you can read either off any page response).
When omitted, the split lands at funnel entry.
Caution: creating a split moves the wrapped step inside a branch sequence,
so an id fetched earlier may no longer sit where you think — read the
funnel structure immediately before creating, and note that anchoring on
a step inside another split's branch nests the new split in that branch.

ConditionalSplitStepParametersUpdate.title: Update Conditional Split Step
ConditionalSplitStepParametersUpdate.description:
Update the `condition` and/or attach pages to existing `branches`. At least one of
the two must be provided.

- `condition.filter_id` is the public id of a RefineFilter in the same workspace.
  Create or update filters via the RefineFilter endpoints. See [Attaching a filter](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/funnels/skill.md#attaching-a-filter)
  and [Applying filters to conditional split steps](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/refine-filters/skill.md#applying-filters-to-conditional-split-steps).
- `branches` must be a 2-entry array (matched, unmatched).
  - `page_id` (single) — when the branch is empty: attach. When the branch already
    has show-page-steps: swap the FIRST step's page (subsequent steps preserved).
  - `page_ids` (array) — APPEND the listed fresh pages to the end of the branch.
    Use this to grow a branch with more sequential steps over multiple PATCHes.
  Both forms are mutually exclusive per entry; any page referenced must be a
  fresh `user_page` in the same workspace with no existing ShowPageStep.

OrderBaseAttributes.description:
Base order attributes used in nested responses (e.g., within invoice responses).
This is a subset of the full OrderAttributes schema.

order_number.description: A sequential number for bookkeeping purposes increased by 1 for each new order in a workspace starting from

total_amount.description: The total amount of the order, considering taxes and discounts.

notes.description: Your internal note about the order. This will be visible in ClickFunnels admin orders-related sections.

live_mode.description: Indicates if the Order will use a live payment gateway and process real credit cards.

billing_status.description:
The billing status reflects the status of the invoice of an order.
Billing status can be one of the following for Payments AI and Stripe orders:
`pending`, `draft`, `paid`, `unpaid`, `partially-refunded`, `refunded`, `voided`, `disputed`, `past-due`.
For external orders, the billing status can be one of: `pending`, `paid`, `unpaid`, `voided` and `refunded`.

service_status.description:
The service status reflects the activity state of the order.
For external one-time orders possible service statuses are `pending` or `completed`.
For external subscription orders possible statuses are `pending`, `active`, `churned`, `canceled`, `completed`, `paused`.

next_charge_at.description: When the next invoice on this subscription falls due. Read-only for processor-managed orders; on an external order it is a plain field you can write.

renewal_at.description:
When the subscription's service period rolls over and the next billing cycle begins.
Distinct from `next_charge_at`, which is when the resulting invoice is due.

Writable on a Payments AI subscription that is `pending`, `active`, or `paused` -
see the `renewal_at` note on `PATCH /orders/{id}`. Read-only on Stripe and external orders.

A write is applied at the payment processor rather than stored. For an actual schedule change,
the order a successful `PATCH` hands back will carry the pre-request stored value. Follow the
`200` / `202` polling conditions on `PATCH /orders/{id}`; a caller timeout means unknown, not
failed.

trial_end_at.description:
When this subscription's trial ends and it converts to a paid charge. Null when the
order never had a trial.

Writable while the order is in a trial. Payments AI also accepts it as the equal companion to
a legal `renewal_at` move while the stored trial end is still in the future - see the
`trial_end_at` note on `PATCH /orders/{id}`.

A write is applied at the payment processor rather than stored. For an actual schedule change,
the order a successful `PATCH` hands back will carry the pre-request stored value. Follow the
`200` / `202` polling conditions on `PATCH /orders/{id}`; a caller timeout means unknown, not
failed.

OrderParameters.title: Orders
OrderParameters.description:
Parameters for creating external orders. External orders are orders managed outside of ClickFunnels payment processors (Payments AI or Stripe).

**Required fields:**
- `order_type`: Must be `one-time-order` or `subscription-order`
- `live_mode`: Must be `true` or `false`
- `contact_id` or `contact_attributes`: Either provide a `contact_id` directly, or use `contact_attributes` with an `email_address` to look up an existing contact
- `line_items_attributes`: At least one line item with `variant_id`, `products_price_id`, and `quantity`

**Note:** For one-time orders, line items must reference one-time products. For subscription orders, line items can include both one-time and subscription products.

order_type.description:
The type of order. Required for creating orders.
- `one-time-order`: A single purchase order. Line items must reference one-time products only.
- `subscription-order`: A recurring subscription order. Line items can include both one-time and subscription products.

live_mode.description:
Required. Indicates if the Order is for production or testing.
- `true`: The order is a live/production order.
- `false`: The order is a test order.

contact_id.description:
The ID of the contact associated with the order.
Either `contact_id` or `contact_attributes` must be provided, but not both.
If both are provided, `contact_id` takes precedence.

contact_attributes.description:
Alternative to `contact_id`. Provide contact attributes to look up an existing contact by email.
The contact must already exist in the workspace - by default, this does not create new contacts.
If `contact_id` is also provided, it takes precedence and `contact_attributes` is ignored.

email_address.description: The email address of an existing contact in the workspace. Required when using contact_attributes.

line_items_attributes.description:
Line items for the order. At least one line item is required.
Each line item must include a valid `variant_id`, `products_price_id`, and `quantity`.

variant_id.description: The ID of the product variant. Must be a valid variant in your workspace.

products_price_id.description: The ID of the price for the product. Must be a valid price for the variant's product.

notes.description: Your internal note about the order. This will be visible in ClickFunnels admin orders-related sections.

billing_status.description:
The billing status reflects the status of the invoice of an order.
Billing status can be one of the following for Payments AI and Stripe orders:
`pending`, `draft`, `paid`, `unpaid`, `partially-refunded`, `refunded`, `voided`, `disputed`, `past-due`.

For external orders, the billing status can be one of: `pending`, `paid`, `unpaid`, `voided` and `refunded`.

service_status.description:
The service status reflects the activity state of the order. For subscriptions, it can control whether a subscription is ongoing, for example despite an irregular (unpaid) invoice status.

For orders with Payments AI as the payment processor, it can be one of the following:
`pending`, `active`, `completed`, `churned`, `canceled`, `suspended`, `paused`, `abandoned`, `voided`
Stripe orders have the same order statuses, except for `voided`. For voided invoices, its service status becomes `abandoned`.
You can read about the state transitions in more detail in our [orders overview guide](https://developers.myclickfunnels.com/docs/orders).

For external one-time orders possible service statuses are `pending` or `completed`. For external subscription orders possible statuses are `pending`, `active`, `churned`, `canceled`, `completed`, `paused`.

next_charge_at.description: The date and time of the next scheduled charge for subscription orders. (External subscription orders only)

cancel_reason.description:
The reason _code_ for the cancelation, it is required when canceling an order.

Possible codes for Payments AI orders are:
`did-not-use`, `did-not-want`, `missing-features`, `too-expensive`, `bugs-or-problems`, `other`

Possible codes for Stripe orders are:
`customer_service`, `low_quality`, `missing_features`, `other`, `switched_service`, `too_complex`, `too_expensive`, `unused`

External orders accept the same cancelation reasons as Stripe.

cancel_description.description: A free-text description of the cancellation reason.

external_id.description: An external ID, e.g., a payment provider's ID or an ID managed by the client internally

OrderParametersUpdate.title: Orders
OrderParametersUpdate.description:
Update parameters for orders. All fields are optional.
Most fields are only applicable to external orders (orders with `payment_processor: external`).

`trial_end_at` and `renewal_at` adjust processor-managed subscription dates. They require the
same permission as the corresponding ClickFunnels screens; unauthorized changes return `404`.
A `null` or unchanged value does not request a schedule change.

trial_end_at.description:
Set the trial end for a Payments AI or Stripe subscription as an absolute RFC 3339 timestamp.
A later value extends the trial and an earlier future value shortens it. The order normally
has `in_trial: true`; Payments AI also accepts `trial_end_at` as the equal companion to a
legal `renewal_at` move while the stored trial end is still in the future.

The timestamp must include a date, time, and UTC offset and be within the next two years.
Moving the trial end also moves the first charge. Send a timestamp a few seconds ahead to
end the trial now.

renewal_at.description:
Set the next billing-cycle start for a Payments AI subscription in `pending`, `active`, or
`paused` state using an absolute RFC 3339 timestamp within the next two years.
This moves the next billing attempt without changing the amount or prorating it.

A renewal cannot precede a future trial end. Send both fields with the same timestamp to end
the trial and bill then. To renew later, update `trial_end_at` first, re-read the order until
it shows the effective new trial end, then update `renewal_at`.

OrderParametersCancel.title: Cancel Order
OrderParametersCancel.description:
Parameters for `POST /orders/{id}/cancel`. All fields are optional — a bare POST (or
`{"order": {}}`) cancels the subscription order with defaults.

This routes the cancelation through ClickFunnels' own cancel path (the same path the
in-app "Cancel subscription" flow uses) so it propagates to the payment processor
(Payments AI/Rebilly or Stripe). A direct `PATCH` of `service_status` to `canceled` is a
no-op for processor-managed orders, which is why this action exists. Only Payments AI
and Stripe subscription orders can be canceled this way; calling it on a one-time order
or an external subscription returns a 422.

cancel_reason.description:
The reason _code_ for the cancelation. Defaults to `other`. Valid values are
processor-specific; a value that isn't accepted for the order's processor returns a 422.

Stripe orders accept:
`customer_service`, `low_quality`, `missing_features`, `other`, `switched_service`, `too_complex`, `too_expensive`, `unused`

Payments AI (Rebilly) orders accept:
`did-not-use`, `did-not-want`, `missing-features`, `too-expensive`, `bugs-or-problems`, `other`

cancel_description.description: A free-text description of the cancellation reason.

effective_date.description:
When the cancelation takes effect.
- `next_renewal`: cancels at the end of the current paid period. Access is retained until `paid_until`.
- Any other value: cancels immediately.

When omitted, it cancels immediately if the order's current period was never paid for
(`billing_status` is `unpaid`, `past-due`, `delinquent`, `failed`, `voided`, `abandoned`
or `disputed`), and at `next_renewal` otherwise.

See [Cancel a subscription](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/orders/skill.md#cancel-a-subscription) in the [Orders Skill](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/orders/skill.md) for
how the period-end and immediate cancels differ and which fields settle later.

cancelation_proration.description: Whether to prorate the cancelation. Defaults to `false`.

canceled_by.description: Attribution for who or what requested the cancelation. It is persisted on the order and recorded in its audit timeline. Defaults to `API`.

voidable_invoices.description:
IDs of the order's invoices to void as part of the cancelation. When omitted, all of the
order's open (`unpaid` or `past-due`) invoices are voided, so the payment processor stops
retrying them. Send `[]` to keep them open. Any other value, such as `null` or a single id
outside an array, returns a 422.

OrdersLineItemsChangeRequest.title: Line Item Change Request
OrdersLineItemsChangeRequest.description: Parameters to preview or commit a subscription line item variant/price change

products_price_id.description:
Target price. Accepts either the integer database id or the obfuscated
`public_id` string returned by the discovery endpoint. The target variant is
derived from the price's `variant` association.

prorate.description:
Optional override for proration. Accepts `true`, `false`, `"true"`, `"false"`,
`"1"`, `"0"`, `1`, or `0`. When omitted, the in-app default is used:
upgrades are prorated and applied immediately; downgrades are not prorated and
take effect at the end of the current billing cycle. Forced to `false` for
physical line items regardless of the value sent. Any other value returns 422.

effective_time.description:
Optional override for when the change takes effect. When omitted (or `null`,
or an empty string), the in-app default is used: upgrades take effect now,
downgrades at the next renewal. Any other value (e.g. `end_of_period` or a
literal timestamp) returns 422.

OrdersLineItemsChangeResponse.title: Line Item Change
OrdersLineItemsChangeResponse.description:
Result of a subscription line item variant/price change. The same envelope is returned
for both preview and commit endpoints — the `preview` flag indicates which.

`upcoming_invoice` is a snapshot of the upcoming-invoice impact of the change as quoted
by the upstream payment platform. It is **informational** — the line item is mutated
regardless of whether the quote succeeds. On commit, the quote is snapshotted just
before the change is applied so consumers don't need a separate preview round-trip
to know what their customer will be charged. Individual amount fields may be `null`
if the upstream quote returned no data; `currency` and `next_invoice_date` fall back
to the order's stored currency and renewal date in that case.

preview.description:
`true` for the preview endpoint, `false` for the commit endpoint. The remainder
of the envelope is shaped identically; the flag lets clients render the same UI
or write the same parsing code for both calls.

upcoming_invoice.description:
Snapshot of the upcoming-invoice impact of the change as quoted by the upstream
payment platform. Populated on both preview and commit (commit snapshots a quote
inside the change transaction so the response carries the same fields as preview).
Informational only — the line item change is committed regardless of whether the
quote succeeds.

total_amount.description: Upcoming invoice total quoted by the payment platform. `null` if the quote returned no data.

subtotal_amount.description: Upcoming invoice subtotal quoted by the payment platform. `null` if the quote returned no data.

tax_amount.description: Upcoming invoice tax quoted by the payment platform. `null` if the quote returned no data.

shipping_amount.description: Upcoming invoice shipping quoted by the payment platform. `null` if the quote returned no data.

discount_amount.description: Upcoming invoice discount quoted by the payment platform. `null` if the quote returned no data.

currency.description:
Currency of the upcoming invoice quote. Falls back to the order's stored
currency if the quote returned no data.

next_invoice_date.description:
Upcoming invoice date as quoted by the payment platform. Falls back to the
order's stored renewal date if the quote returned no data.

previous_line_item.description:
The line item as it was before the change — same `id` as the current line item,
but with `products_price` and `products_variant` reflecting the pre-change
target.

new_line_item.description:
The line item as it would be after the change (preview) or as it now is after
the change (commit) — same `id` as the current line item, with `products_price`
and `products_variant` reflecting the target.

status.description:
The billing status reflects the status of the invoice's payment.
Billing status can be one of the following for Payments AI orders: `draft`, `paid`, `unpaid`, `partially-refunded`, `refunded`, `voided`, `disputed`, `past-due`.

External invoice statuses of external one-time orders can be one of the following: `unpaid`, `paid`, `voided` and `refunded`, `disputed`, `past-due`.
A change in status will update the `billing_status` of the parent order. If the status of a one-time order is changed to `paid`, the order's `service_status` will also be flipped to `completed`.

shipping_amount.description: Invoiced shipping amount. Cannot be negative.

currency.description: The currency for the invoice. Automatically set to the parent order's currency when creating an invoice for an external order through the API.

issued_at.description: The date the invoice was issued.

due_at.description: The date the invoice is due.

paid_at.description: The date the invoice was paid.

invoice_number.description: The number of the invoice. Usually, this is a sequential number in a certain format to be used for bookkeeping purposes.

fulfillment_status.description:
The fulfillment status of the invoice.
This can be one of:
 - `not_applicable` - the invoice is not eligible for fulfillment
 - `unfulfilled` - the entire invoice needs to be fulfilled
 - `partial` - some items have been fulfilled, but some are pending or restocked
 - `complete` - all items are fulfilled

payment_processor.description: The payment processor of the invoice's order. Currently, it can be one of `payments_ai` and `external`.

eligible_for_fulfillment.description: Invoice has been paid so is eligible for fulfillment (does not indicate if the invoice has any fulfillable items)

visits.description: Visit tracking information from the parent order. Contains last_visit and last_visit_with_utm (but not first_visit, which belongs to the contact).

OrdersInvoiceParameters.title: External Invoice
OrdersInvoiceParameters.description:
Parameters for creating an external invoice. Only external orders support invoice creation via the API.
External orders are orders where payments are processed outside of ClickFunnels.

external_id.description:
Required. A unique identifier for this invoice in your external system.
This ID allows you to correlate ClickFunnels invoices with records in your payment processor.

status.description:
Required. The billing status of the invoice.

For external one-time orders, valid statuses are: `unpaid`, `paid`, `voided`, `refunded`, `disputed`, `past-due`.
For external subscription orders, the same statuses apply.

When creating an invoice with status `paid`, you must also provide `paid_at`.
A change in status will update the `billing_status` of the parent order.
If a one-time order's invoice status is changed to `paid`, the order's `service_status` will also flip to `completed`.

invoice_type.description:
The type of invoice. If not provided, defaults based on the order type:
- For one-time orders: `one_time_sale`
- For subscription orders: `initial`

For subscription orders, valid types are: `initial`, `renewal`, `interim`, `cancellation`, `one_time`, `refund`, `charge`.
For one-time orders, only `one_time_sale` is valid.

invoice_number.description:
Optional. A sequential number for bookkeeping purposes.
If not provided, one will be auto-generated.

shipping_amount.description: Invoiced shipping amount. Cannot be negative. Defaults to "0.00".

issued_at.description: The date the invoice was issued.

due_at.description: The date the invoice is due.

paid_at.description: The date the invoice was paid. Required when `status` is `paid`.

line_items_attributes.description:
Line items for the invoice. Each line item represents a product/variant being invoiced.
Required fields for each line item: `amount`, `quantity`, `variant_id`, `products_price_id`.

amount.description: The price amount for this line item.

description.description: Optional description for the line item.

OrdersInvoiceParametersUpdate.title: External Invoice Update

status.description:
The billing status of the invoice.

For external orders, valid statuses are: `unpaid`, `paid`, `voided`, `refunded`, `disputed`, `past-due`.

When changing status to `paid`, you must also provide `paid_at`.
A change in status will update the `billing_status` of the parent order.
If a one-time order's invoice status is changed to `paid`, the order's `service_status` will also flip to `completed`.

external_id.description:
The unique identifier for this invoice in your external system.
This ID allows you to correlate ClickFunnels invoices with records in your payment processor.

invoice_number.description: A sequential number for bookkeeping purposes.

shipping_amount.description: Invoiced shipping amount. Cannot be negative.

issued_at.description: The date the invoice was issued.

due_at.description: The date the invoice is due.

paid_at.description: The date the invoice was paid. Required when changing `status` to `paid`.

line_items_attributes.description:
Update existing line items. Only line items with an `id` will be processed;
new line items (without `id`) are ignored during updates.

id.description:
Required. The ID of the existing line item to update.
Line items without an ID are ignored during updates.

amount.description: The price amount for this line item.

description.description: Optional description for the line item.

fulfillment_status.description:
Represents the current fulfillment status of the line item.
This can be one of the following:
 - `unfulfilled` - the line item has not been fully fulfilled (fulfilled quantity is 0)
 - `partially_fulfilled` - the line item is partially fulfilled (fulfilled quantity is less than line item quantity)
 - `complete` - the line item is completely fulfilled (fulfilled quantity is equal to line item quantity)
 - `ignored` - the line item is marked as ignored for fulfillment

description.description: The description of the variant. The description of the **default variant** is the user-facing description of the `Product`.

products_variant.name: Seinfeld In Your Pocket - Comedy Joke Machine (Black Premium)

OrdersTransactionParametersRefund.title: Refund Transaction
OrdersTransactionParametersRefund.description:
Parameters for `POST /orders/transactions/{id}/refund`. Every field is optional - a bare POST
(or `{"orders_transaction": {}}`) refunds the addressed charge with defaults.

The refund is always for the charge's full outstanding amount, so there is no amount to send.
Partial refunds are deliberately not offered here: they are a human-gated exception, handled in
the ClickFunnels admin.

reason.description:
Defaults to `requested_by_customer`.

Stripe orders accept only `duplicate`, `fraudulent`, or `requested_by_customer`; any other
value returns 422 listing the accepted set. Payments AI (Rebilly) orders treat this as a
free-text description that is recorded on the refund and the order timeline.

partial.description:
Must be `false` or omitted. Sending `true` returns 422 rather than silently refunding the
full charge. An `amount` field is rejected the same way - honoring it would be a partial
refund, and ignoring it would refund more than you asked for.

description.description: The description of the variant. The description of the **default variant** is the user-facing description of the `Product`.

original_product.name: Seinfeld In Your Pocket - Comedy Joke Machine (Black Premium)

products_price.name: Seinfeld In Your Pocket - Comedy Joke Machine (Black Premium)

products_variant.name: Seinfeld In Your Pocket - Comedy Joke Machine (Black Premium)

public_id.description: The public identifier of the page

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID that the page belongs to.

name.description: Page name of the editable page element. Want to filter by it? See our help guide on that topic.

description.description: A short description of the page (max 1000 characters).

seo_title.description: Custom title for search engine results. Falls back to the site's SEO title if not set.

seo_description.description: Custom meta description for search engine results. Falls back to the site's SEO description if not set.

seo_index.description: Whether search engines should index this page. Defaults to false.

block_ai_crawler.description: Whether AI training crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, CCBot and others) are blocked from using this page's content to train models. Defaults to false. Enforced by a `Disallow` rule in the domain's robots.txt — see [Crawler access (AI opt-out)](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/pages/skill.md#crawler-access-ai-opt-out) in the [Pages Skill](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/pages/skill.md) for coverage limits. Independent of `seo_index` and of the other two AI flags.

block_ai_search.description: Whether AI answer engines (OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot and others) are blocked from indexing this page and citing it when people ask questions. Defaults to false. Enforced via robots.txt. See [Crawler access (AI opt-out)](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/pages/skill.md#crawler-access-ai-opt-out) in the [Pages Skill](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/pages/skill.md) for coverage limits.

block_ai_assistant.description: Whether AI assistants (ChatGPT-User, Claude-User, Perplexity-User and others) are blocked from opening this page when a person asks them to — for example pasting the page's link into a chat. Defaults to false. Enforced via robots.txt. See [Crawler access (AI opt-out)](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/pages/skill.md#crawler-access-ai-opt-out) in the [Pages Skill](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/pages/skill.md) for coverage limits.

type.description: The type of page. Can be one of `landing_page`, `site_page`, `funnel_page` or `theme_page`. May be `null` for a page that matches none of these categories.

custom_html_page.description: Whether this is a ClickFunnels-hosted custom HTML page — a page whose entire body is author-supplied HTML served verbatim (no page editor, no PML). Read the HTML via `GET /pages/{id}/custom_html` and replace it by sending the write-only `custom_html` string on `PATCH /pages/{id}`. Create these via `POST /workspaces/{workspace_id}/pages/custom_html`. (Deliberately named differently from the `custom_html` request field so echoing a GET payload back into PATCH never collides.)

current_path.description: The current URL path for the page resource. This is the canonical URL for landing and site pages. `null` for externally-hosted (SDK) pages. **For funnel pages this is NOT the customer-facing URL** — that's `url` (or `show_page_step.current_path` for the path component). The page-level current_path on a funnel page does not route the visitor through the workflow step, so a `<checkout/>` element on it will not see the step's attached products. See [Setting a page's path (`current_path`)](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/pages/skill.md#setting-a-pages-path-current_path) in the [Pages Skill](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/pages/skill.md).

url.description: The customer-facing URL for the page on the live site. For funnel pages this routes through the workflow step (which feeds `<checkout/>` its IncludedProducts). Always prefer this over `current_path` when constructing links.

show_page_step.description: The show page step (the workflow step's _function_) associated with this page. The `products` array is the live list of products attached to this step's checkout — main products and order bumps alike, each flagged by its own `bump` field; it is mutated via `show_page_step.product_ids` / `show_page_step.bumps` on page create/update (additive) and `DELETE /api/v2/pages/:id/products` (removal).

id.description: The ID of the show page step (function). Pass this as `show_page_step_id` when positioning split-test or conditional-split steps via `/api/v2/funnels/:id/split_test_steps` and `/api/v2/funnels/:id/conditional_split_steps`.

public_id.description: The public identifier of the show page step (function). May be passed as `show_page_step_id` alongside other `public_id` references in your code.

name.description: The name of the step in the funnel. This is the page name that is visible in the funnel builder for a show page step.

current_path.description: The current URL path for the step in the funnel. This is the path component of the live, customer-facing URL for funnel pages. `null` for externally-hosted (SDK) pages.

sort_order.description: The zero-based position of this step within the funnel. The first step is 0, the second is 1, and so on. Returned in every page response; pass `sort_order` on create/update to control positioning.

products.description: Products currently attached to this step's checkout, main products and order bumps together in display order. Mutated via `show_page_step.product_ids` (main) and `show_page_step.bumps` (bumps) on page create/update (additive) and `DELETE /api/v2/pages/:id/products` (removal, either kind).

bump.description: Whether this product is attached as an **order bump** (an optional add-on offered next to the main products) rather than a main product. `true` for products served to `<checkout/>` and to the SDK as `bumpProducts`. Set via `show_page_step.bumps` on page create/update.

bump_preheadline.description: The short line of copy shown above this order bump's offer, when one was set via that bump's `preheadline` in `show_page_step.bumps`. Always `null` for products that are not bumps.

funnel.description: The funnel associated with this page (if the page is part of a funnel)

id.description: The unique identifier of the funnel

public_id.description: The public identifier of the funnel

sdk.description: Present for SDK-enabled pages — externally-hosted (SDK) pages and ClickFunnels-hosted custom HTML pages; `null` for other pages. Contains the SDK integration token, plus the external URL for externally-hosted pages.

token.description: The SDK page token (prefixed `cfp_`). Embed this in the page via a `<meta name="cf-page-token" content="<token>">` tag and include the SDK script tag to register the page with ClickFunnels. See [The entire public surface](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/sdk/create-external-page/skill.md#the-entire-public-surface) in the [Create an External Page Skill](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/sdk/create-external-page/skill.md) for the exact tags to paste.

external_url.description: The fully-qualified URL of the externally-hosted page. Only present for externally-hosted pages (absent for custom HTML pages, which live on the funnel's own domain).

head_code.description: **Expandable** Custom HTML/JavaScript code injected into the page head section. Only returned when expand[]=head_code is provided. Note: expanding may add latency, especially on list endpoints. Use sparingly.

footer_code.description: **Expandable** Custom HTML/JavaScript code injected before the closing body tag. Only returned when expand[]=footer_code is provided. Note: expanding may add latency, especially on list endpoints. Use sparingly.

custom_css.description: **Expandable** Raw CSS applied at the page level (no <style> wrapper). Maps to the CSS tab in the page editor's Code Editor panel. Internal pages only. Only returned when expand[]=custom_css is provided. Note: expanding may add latency, especially on list endpoints. Use sparingly.

markup.description: **Expandable** The PML (Page Markup Language) representation of the page's visual tree. Only returned when expand[]=markup is provided. Note: expanding may add latency, especially on list endpoints. This serialization is lossy: elements PML has no equivalent for are omitted with no error and no placeholder, so a round-tripped read is not a safe basis for rewriting a page (see [the approval guardrail](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/page-markup/skill.md#stop-get-approval-before-overwriting-an-existing-page)). An empty string therefore does not prove the page is empty: a page built entirely from elements PML cannot express also reads back empty. The value `<!-- markup unavailable: page tree could not be serialized -->` means the read failed; treat the page as unreadable and do not write that string back. See the [Page Markup Skill](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/page-markup/skill.md) for the full DSL reference.

name.description: Page name of the editable page element.

current_path.description: The URL path for the page. If left blank, a randomized path will be generated. When attaching to a funnel, this value becomes the ShowPageStep path (the user-facing URL), and the page's own current_path will be set to a randomized value with a suffix, since the ShowPageStep path is the source of truth for funnel pages. See [Setting a page's path (`current_path`)](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/pages/skill.md#setting-a-pages-path-current_path) in the [Pages Skill](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/pages/skill.md) for the path rules.

theme_id.description: The ID of the theme to use for this page.

description.description: A short description of the page (max 1000 characters).

seo_title.description: Custom title for search engine results.

seo_description.description: Custom meta description for search engine results.

seo_index.description: Whether search engines should index this page. Defaults to false.

block_ai_crawler.description: Block AI training crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended and others) from using this page's content to train models. Defaults to false. Enforced via robots.txt — see [Crawler access (AI opt-out)](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/pages/skill.md#crawler-access-ai-opt-out) in the [Pages Skill](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/pages/skill.md) for coverage limits.

block_ai_search.description: Block AI answer engines (OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot and others) from indexing this page and citing it in answers. Defaults to false. See [Crawler access (AI opt-out)](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/pages/skill.md#crawler-access-ai-opt-out) in the [Pages Skill](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/pages/skill.md) for coverage limits.

block_ai_assistant.description: Block AI assistants (ChatGPT-User, Claude-User and others) from opening this page when a person asks them to. Defaults to false. See [Crawler access (AI opt-out)](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/pages/skill.md#crawler-access-ai-opt-out) in the [Pages Skill](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/pages/skill.md) for coverage limits.

sort_order.description: Optional zero-based position within the funnel when creating with `funnel.funnel_id`. `0` inserts before the first step; omit to append at the end. Ignored when `funnel.show_page_step_id` is provided. Out-of-bounds values return 422.

funnel.description: Optional funnel association. Use either funnel_id (to create a new step) or show_page_step_id (to attach to existing step). If both are provided, show_page_step_id takes precedence and funnel_id is ignored.

funnel_id.description: The public ID of the funnel to attach this page to. A new show page step will be created as the last step of the funnel, unless `after_show_page_step_id` is provided.

after_show_page_step_id.description:
Controls where the new step is inserted within the funnel (only relevant when `funnel_id` is provided). Accepts either:
- A ShowPageStep `id` (the function id, as exposed under `show_page_step.id` in page responses) — inserts the new step immediately after the referenced show page step.
- The workflow root step's id (integer) — inserts the new step at the beginning of the funnel.
If omitted or null, the page is appended after the currently last step of the funnel. Returns 400 if the id does not resolve to a valid step in the funnel.

show_page_step_id.description: The ID of an existing show page step to attach this page to. Takes precedence over funnel_id if both are provided.

show_page_step.description: Optional. Mutates the show_page_step that the page is attached to via the `funnel` block above. Only valid when the page is also being linked to a funnel via the `funnel` block — passing `show_page_step.product_ids` or `show_page_step.bumps` without a funnel link returns 400.

product_ids.description: List of product public IDs to append to the step's checkout as regular (main) products. This is **additive** — products are appended to any products already on the step (relevant when `funnel.show_page_step_id` is used to attach to an existing step); products already attached are skipped. All-or-nothing — if any ID does not resolve to a workspace product, the page is not created and a 400 is returned. To remove products, use `DELETE /api/v2/pages/:id/products`. See [Manage products on a checkout page](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/pages/skill.md#manage-products-on-a-checkout-page) in the [Pages Skill](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/pages/skill.md).

bumps.description: Products to attach to the step as **order bumps** — the optional add-ons offered next to the main products, served to `<checkout/>` and to the SDK as `bumpProducts`. One object per bump, each carrying its own copy. Same additive, all-or-nothing semantics as `product_ids`. A product already attached to the step as a main product is promoted to a bump in place (it keeps its position and its configured variants/prices). A product named in both `product_ids` and `bumps` in the same request is a 400 — a product is either a main product or a bump on a given step, never both. To turn a bump back into a main product, detach it with `DELETE /api/v2/pages/:id/products` and re-attach it via `product_ids`.

product_id.description: Public ID of the product to attach as an order bump. Required on every entry; an entry without one is a 400.

preheadline.description: Optional short line of copy shown above this bump's offer (for example "One-time offer"). Omit to leave any copy already set on the bump alone. Read it back under `show_page_step.products[].bump_preheadline`.

head_code.description: Custom code to inject into the page's <head> section. Content should be wrapped in appropriate HTML tags such as <script>, <link>, <meta>, or <style>. Set to null to clear existing code.

head_code_mode.description: How to handle head_code. 'append' adds to existing code (default), 'replace' overwrites.

footer_code.description: Custom code to inject before the closing </body> tag. JavaScript should be wrapped in <script> tags. Set to null to clear existing code.

footer_code_mode.description: How to handle footer_code. 'append' adds to existing code (default), 'replace' overwrites.

custom_css.description: Raw CSS to apply at the page level (no <style> wrapper). Maps to the CSS tab in the page editor's Code Editor panel. Internal pages only. Set to null to clear existing CSS.

custom_css_mode.description: How to handle custom_css. 'append' adds to existing CSS (default), 'replace' overwrites.

markup.description: A valid PML (Page Markup Language) string that replaces the page's visual tree. Page metadata (name, path, SEO settings) is preserved. Markup that stops mid-construct (a tag, attribute value, comment or `<customhtml>` body that never closes, or elements still open at the end of the document) is rejected with a 400 and the page is not created — re-send the complete document rather than the missing tail. See the [Page Markup Skill](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/page-markup/skill.md) for the full DSL reference. The parser errors are listed under [Common Validation Errors](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/page-markup/skill.md#common-validation-errors).

PageParametersUpdate.title: Pages
PageParametersUpdate.description:
Update parameters for a page. Field availability depends on the page type:

**Shared (all page types):** `name`, `description`, `sort_order`, `funnel.show_page_step_id`, `show_page_step.product_ids`, `show_page_step.bumps`.

**Internal (editor) pages only** (returns 422 on external and custom HTML pages): `markup`, `theme_id`, `seo_title`, `seo_description`, `head_code`, `footer_code`, `custom_css`, `live_data_changes`.

**Internal and custom HTML pages** (returns 422 on external pages): `seo_index`, `block_ai_crawler`, `block_ai_search`, `block_ai_assistant`. These act on the page's URL rather than its content (the domain's `sitemap.xml` and `robots.txt`), so they apply to a custom HTML page too. A custom HTML page's own HTML sets its title and meta tags, which is why `seo_title` and `seo_description` are not accepted there.

**External-only** (returns 422 on other page types): `external_url`.

**Custom HTML pages only** (returns 422 on other page types): `custom_html`. Custom HTML pages also accept `current_path` (like internal pages) — it moves the funnel step's path when the page is a funnel step, or the page's own path when standalone.

The three `block_ai_*` flags are accepted on any internal or custom HTML page. robots.txt expresses the block at every path ClickFunnels serves the page at on its domain: the page's own URL, its funnel step paths, and `/` when it is the site's home page. A page that is only served through another resource's URL (a theme or template page other than the home page, a blog or course page) contributes no rules, so its preference is stored and read back but not enforced. A `200` is therefore not proof that a page is blocked; fetch the domain's `/robots.txt` to confirm. See [Crawler access (AI opt-out)](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/pages/skill.md#crawler-access-ai-opt-out) in the [Pages Skill](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/pages/skill.md).

name.description: Page name of the editable page element.

description.description: A short description of the page (max 1000 characters).

sort_order.description: Reposition the page within its funnel. Zero-based. `0` moves it to the first position. The page must belong to exactly one funnel step; pages with zero or multiple funnel steps return 422. Out-of-bounds values return 422. Ignored when `funnel.show_page_step_id` is also provided — the swap target's position takes precedence.

funnel.description: Optional funnel mutation block. On update, only `show_page_step_id` is supported — swap the page onto an existing show page step.

show_page_step_id.description: The ID of an existing show page step to attach this page to. The page previously linked to that step becomes an orphan (kept in the workspace, no longer linked to any step). Shared by both internal and external pages.

current_path.description: Move the page's URL path (e.g. `/my-page`). Internal and custom HTML pages — returns 422 on external pages. For a custom HTML page that is a funnel step, this moves the STEP's path (the customer-facing URL); when standalone, the page's own path. Returns 422 when the page backs more than one funnel step — the target would be ambiguous.

custom_html.description: Replace the entire HTML body of a custom HTML page (max 2MB). An empty or whitespace-only string is rejected with a 422 (omit the field to leave the body unchanged). The stored HTML is served verbatim at the page's URL; the edge cache is purged on write. Custom HTML pages only — returns 422 on other page types. Read the current HTML via `GET /pages/{id}/custom_html`.

seo_title.description: Custom title for search engine results. Internal pages only — returns 422 on external and custom HTML pages.

seo_description.description: Custom meta description for search engine results. Internal pages only — returns 422 on external and custom HTML pages.

seo_index.description: Whether search engines should index this page. An indexable funnel step page is listed in its domain's `sitemap.xml`. Internal and custom HTML pages — returns 422 on external pages.

block_ai_crawler.description: Block AI training crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended and others) from using this page's content to train models. Internal and custom HTML pages — returns 422 on external pages. See [Crawler access (AI opt-out)](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/pages/skill.md#crawler-access-ai-opt-out) in the [Pages Skill](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/pages/skill.md) for coverage limits.

block_ai_search.description: Block AI answer engines (OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot and others) from indexing this page and citing it in answers. Internal and custom HTML pages — returns 422 on external pages. See [Crawler access (AI opt-out)](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/pages/skill.md#crawler-access-ai-opt-out) in the [Pages Skill](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/pages/skill.md) for coverage limits.

block_ai_assistant.description: Block AI assistants (ChatGPT-User, Claude-User and others) from opening this page when a person asks them to. Internal and custom HTML pages — returns 422 on external pages. See [Crawler access (AI opt-out)](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/pages/skill.md#crawler-access-ai-opt-out) in the [Pages Skill](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/pages/skill.md) for coverage limits.

head_code.description: Custom code to inject into the page's <head> section. Internal pages only — returns 422 on external pages. Set to null to clear existing code.

head_code_mode.description: How to handle head_code. 'append' adds to existing code (default), 'replace' overwrites. Internal pages only.

footer_code.description: Custom code to inject before the closing </body> tag. Internal pages only — returns 422 on external pages. Set to null to clear existing code.

footer_code_mode.description: How to handle footer_code. 'append' adds to existing code (default), 'replace' overwrites. Internal pages only.

custom_css.description: Raw CSS to apply at the page level (no <style> wrapper). Maps to the CSS tab in the page editor's Code Editor panel. Internal pages only — returns 422 on external pages. Set to null to clear existing CSS.

custom_css_mode.description: How to handle custom_css. 'append' adds to existing CSS (default), 'replace' overwrites. Internal pages only.

markup.description: A valid PML (Page Markup Language) string that replaces live visual content; it is not a saved-draft promotion and does not promise deletion of an existing draft blob. PML covers only a subset of what the ClickFunnels page editor can build, so round-tripping an editor page through PML can silently drop content it cannot express. **If the page could have been created or edited in the ClickFunnels editor, stop and get explicit approval from the user before sending this** (a general instruction to update or publish the page does not count): see [the approval guardrail](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/page-markup/skill.md#stop-get-approval-before-overwriting-an-existing-page). Internal pages only — returns 422 on external pages. Markup that stops mid-construct (a tag, attribute value, comment or `<customhtml>` body that never closes, or elements still open at the end of the document) is rejected with a 400 and the page is left untouched — re-send the complete document rather than the missing tail. To add a tracking pixel or other custom code, use `head_code`/`footer_code` instead of rewriting the body; see [Add a tracking pixel or custom code](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/pages/skill.md#add-a-tracking-pixel-or-custom-code). See the [Page Markup Skill](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/page-markup/skill.md) for the full DSL reference. The parser errors are listed under [Common Validation Errors](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/page-markup/skill.md#common-validation-errors).

external_url.description: Update the external URL for an SDK page. External pages only — returns 422 on internal pages. The SDK token is preserved across URL updates. To move external pages to a new origin, see the [Migrate an External Page Domain Skill](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/sdk/migrate-external-page-domain/skill.md#4-patch-one-page-at-a-time).

show_page_step.description: Optional. Mutates the show_page_step that this page is attached to. Only valid when the page is part of a funnel — passing `show_page_step.product_ids` or `show_page_step.bumps` for a page that isn't linked to a funnel returns 400. Shared by both internal and external pages.

product_ids.description: List of product public IDs to append to the step's checkout as regular (main) products. This is **additive** — products listed are appended; products already attached are skipped; no products are ever removed via this field, and an existing order bump is never demoted back to a main product by it. All-or-nothing — if any ID does not resolve to a workspace product, no changes are saved and a 400 is returned. To remove products, use `DELETE /api/v2/pages/:id/products`. See [Manage products on a checkout page](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/pages/skill.md#manage-products-on-a-checkout-page) in the [Pages Skill](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/pages/skill.md).

bumps.description: Products to attach to the step as **order bumps** — the optional add-ons offered next to the main products, served to `<checkout/>` and to the SDK as `bumpProducts`. One object per bump, each carrying its own copy. Same additive, all-or-nothing semantics as `product_ids`. A product already attached to the step as a main product is promoted to a bump in place (it keeps its position and its configured variants/prices), which is how you turn an existing attachment into a bump. A product named in both `product_ids` and `bumps` in the same request is a 400 — a product is either a main product or a bump on a given step, never both. To turn a bump back into a main product, detach it with `DELETE /api/v2/pages/:id/products` and re-attach it via `product_ids`.

product_id.description: Public ID of the product to attach as an order bump. Required on every entry; an entry without one is a 400.

preheadline.description: Optional short line of copy shown above this bump's offer (for example "One-time offer"). Sending it for a product that is already a bump replaces that bump's copy, so this is also how you edit it; omit it to leave the current copy alone. Read it back under `show_page_step.products[].bump_preheadline`.

self_upgrade.description: Legacy setting with no effect: no checkout, customer portal or API plan change reads it. `GET /products/prices/{price_id}/change_options` lists the upgrades and downgrades the API allows from this price.

self_downgrade.description: Legacy setting with no effect: no checkout, customer portal or API plan change reads it. `GET /products/prices/{price_id}/change_options` lists the upgrades and downgrades the API allows from this price.

amount.description: Amount, as a decimal string. Omitting it does not fail — it silently creates a free price ('0.00') — so always send it.

currency.description: Currency. Ignored on write — a price always takes its workspace's currency, so sending a different one has no effect.

duration.description: Amount of payments. Required when payment_type is payment_plan; ignored for one_time and subscription.

interval.description: Billing period unit — note the values are plural ('months', not 'month'). Required when payment_type is subscription or payment_plan; ignored for one_time.

trial_interval.description: Trial period unit — same plural values as interval. An active recurring trial needs BOTH trial_interval and a positive trial_duration. Send both together: trial_duration alone is stored but inactive until trial_interval is added later, while trial_interval alone is cleared. Trial fields are cleared on a one_time price.

trial_duration.description: Length of the trial, in trial_interval units. Send a positive value together with trial_interval to create an active trial. Sent alone, it is stored but remains inactive until trial_interval is added later.

trial_amount.description: Amount charged for the trial. Leave at '0.00' for a free trial, or set it above 0 for a paid one. Only applies when trial_interval and trial_duration are both set.

self_upgrade.description: Legacy setting with no effect: no checkout, customer portal or API plan change reads it. `GET /products/prices/{price_id}/change_options` lists the upgrades and downgrades the API allows from this price.

self_downgrade.description: Legacy setting with no effect: no checkout, customer portal or API plan change reads it. `GET /products/prices/{price_id}/change_options` lists the upgrades and downgrades the API allows from this price.

interval_count.description: How many intervals between charges — interval 'months' with interval_count 3 bills every 3 months. Required when payment_type is subscription or payment_plan.

currency.description: Currency. Ignored on write — a price always takes its workspace's currency, so sending a different one has no effect.

duration.description: Amount of payments. Only used by a payment_plan price.

interval.description: Billing period unit — note the values are plural ('months', not 'month'). Only used by a subscription or payment_plan price.

trial_interval.description: Trial period unit — same plural values as interval. An active recurring trial needs this field and a positive trial_duration. Adding it to a price with a stored trial_duration activates the trial. Clearing only this field leaves the duration stored but inactive. Trial fields are cleared on a one_time price.

RefineFilterCriterion.title: Refine Filter Criterion
RefineFilterCriterion.description: A single filter criterion consisting of an attribute, a comparison clause, and a value.

attribute.description:
The contact attribute to filter on (e.g. `tags.id`, `created_at`, `email_address`).
The public API restricts attributes to a [safe whitelist](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/refine-filters/skill.md#safe-condition-whitelist) — see the [Refine Filters Skill](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/refine-filters/skill.md) for the full reference.

clause.description:
The comparison operator for this criterion (e.g. `in`, `eq`, `gte`, `lte`, `st`, `nst`).
Allowed clauses depend on the attribute. Text attributes (`email_address`, `first_name`, `last_name`) only accept `eq` and `sw` on the public API; see the [Refine Filters Skill](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/refine-filters/skill.md#safe-condition-whitelist).

value.description:
The comparison value. Type depends on the attribute and clause:
- **Option conditions** (tags, products, etc.): a single opaque public id string, or an array of public id strings.
- **Date/datetime conditions**: an ISO 8601 date string (`"2026-01-01"`) or datetime string (`"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"`).
  For `between`/`not_between` clauses supply an array of exactly two date strings.
  For relative `gt`, `lt`, or `exct` clauses supply an object with `days` and a `modifier` of `ago` or `from_now`.
- **Text/numeric conditions**: a plain string or number.
- **Set/not-set clauses**: omit `value` entirely.

`null` when the criterion carries no value, as set/not-set clauses do.

days.description: Number of days used by a relative date clause.

date_refinement.description: Additional event-date comparison for an attribute that supports date refinement. Preserve this object when reusing a returned criterion; it narrows the audience independently of the selected event IDs.

clause.description: Date comparison operator, such as gte, btwn, or lt.

value.description: ISO8601 date or datetime, two dates for btwn/nbtwn, or days and modifier for relative gt/lt/exct comparisons.

RefineFilterAttributes.title: Refine Filter
RefineFilterAttributes.description:
A reusable workspace-scoped audience filter composed of one or more criteria joined by a single conjunction.

Public API requests are validated against a [safe-condition whitelist](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/refine-filters/skill.md#safe-condition-whitelist); criteria outside the whitelist return 422 with a pointer to the developer community.

externalDocs.description: Refine Filters Skill - attributes, clauses, and worked examples

workspace_id.description: ID of the workspace this filter belongs to

name.description: Optional human-readable name for the filter. Must be unique within the workspace when set.

filter_class.description: The filter class recorded on the saved filter. This API authors `ContactsFilter` and applies `ContactsFilter` and `OrdersFilter`, but the list returns every saved filter in the workspace, and other ClickFunnels surfaces save their own classes here — `ContactsSegmentsFilter`, `ProductsFilter`, `FunnelsFilter` and `ContactUpsellsFilter` all appear in real workspaces. Treat this as an open set: match on the class you want rather than assuming the rest are absent. `null` for a legacy row whose stored state can no longer be decoded (such rows also return empty `criteria`; they can still be deleted).

conjunction.description: How the criteria are joined — `and` (all must match) or `or` (any must match).

mixed_conjunctions.description: True when the saved filter joins its conditions with both `and` and `or`, as filters grouped in the UI can. `conjunction` and `criteria` then summarize it as one conjunction over all criteria rather than restating it; request `results` for its exact matches, and do not rebuild it from `criteria`.

RefineFilterParametersCreate.title: Create Refine Filter
RefineFilterParametersCreate.description:
Parameters for creating a new RefineFilter. The `criteria` array must contain at least one entry.
Each criterion requires `attribute` and `clause`; `value` may be omitted for set/not-set clauses.

### Supported conditions (public API)

The public API restricts criteria to the safe whitelist below. Requests
outside this set return 422 with a pointer to the dev community for
new-condition requests.

| Condition                                                                        | Allowed clauses                                                  | Notes                                                              |
|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `email_address`, `first_name`, `last_name`                                       | `eq`, `sw`                                                        | Text — equals & starts_with only.                                  |
| `anonymous`                                                                      | `eq`, `dne`                                                       | Boolean-style option.                                              |
| `created_at`, `unsubscribed_at`, `last_activity`                                | All standard date clauses                                         | Indexed datetime columns.                                          |
| `tags.id`                                                                        | `eq`, `dne`, `in`, `nin`                                          | Tag membership — must reference workspace-owned tag ids.           |
| `has_affiliate_attribution`, `has_active_affiliate_attribution`, `referred_by_affiliate` | All standard clauses                                  | Affiliate attribution lookups.                                     |
| `email_suppression`                                                              | `st`, `nst`, `eq`, `in`                                           | Email suppression set/not-set or membership.                       |
| `received_broadcast`, `opened_broadcast`, `clicked_broadcast`                   | `eq`, `in`                                                        | **Must include a specific broadcast id.**                          |
| `opted_in_funnel_step`, `opted_in_funnel_at`, `opted_in_on_standalone_page`     | `eq`, `in`                                                        | **Must include a specific funnel/step/page id.**                   |

Conjunction is restricted to `and`. See the full reference at the
[Refine Filters Skill](https://accounts.myclickfunnels.com/.well-known/refine-filters/skill.md#safe-condition-whitelist).

conjunction.description: Join operator for all criteria. Defaults to `and`.

value.description: Comparison value. Relative date clauses use an object with `days` and `modifier`. Omit for set/not-set clauses.
